entry.author: AntarcticaNZ
entry.summary:
The Onyx is the longest river in Antarctica. Most years it starts flowing in late December/early January. It flows from the sea end of the Wright Valley into Lake Vanda. Lake vanda has NO outlet. So where does the water go? It evaporates.

Lake Vanda is situated in the amazing Dry Valley Region of Antarctica.
